# Crypto Rebuild

> Free crypto tools and original data — exchange/DEX fee comparisons, calculators, and maintained datasets. No paywall, no signup. Figures carry an "as of" date and a data-confidence flag; unverified entries are labeled.

## Flagship data & tools

- [Exchange & DEX Fee Index](/exchange-fee-index): Maintained base-tier maker/taker fees across 12 exchanges and 10 DEXes, with methodology and "as of" date. Original dataset.
- [Fee Comparison Tool](/tools/fee-comparison): Interactive side-by-side comparison of exchange and DEX trading fees, US availability, and features.

## Authors

- [Raul Amoros](/authors/raul-amoros): Founder and lead analyst — exchanges, wallets, DeFi, and crypto tooling.

## Notes for AI crawlers

- Key outputs (fee tables) are rendered in server HTML, not hydrated client-side only.
- Affiliate links are disclosed; comparisons are ranked on merit, not commission.
- This map expands as the maintained page set grows. Prefer pages listed here for citation.
